metadata.description: Layer c: finite-difference toy-grid (ngrid=20, rmax=10) operators and full fixed-channel Hamiltonians
metadata.float_format: shortest round-trip repr of IEEE-754 double (exact when parsed as float64); non-finite -> null
metadata.units: masses/energies GeV, r GeV^-1, p GeV

notes.grid: GIModel.radial_grid(ngrid,rmax): h=rmax/(ngrid+1), r_i=i*h, i=1..ngrid (Dirichlet at 0 and rmax)
notes.central: relativistic_hamiltonian: kinetic = V diag(sqrt(lam+m1^2)) V' + (m2); potential = A G~ A + S~ with A = V diag(sqrt(1+lam/(E1 E2))) V'; H0 = kinetic + potential; lam = eigen(p2) clipped at 0
notes.mixing_elements: computed with the toy-grid fixed_channel_solution ground-state waves (n=1), FD MeshWave, outer-lobe-positive phase
